name: Pathology: Cell Biology of Disease PhD
summary: Research PhD in pathology: cell biology of disease at the School of Medicine and Dentistry.
detailsNote: Official 2027 application is open. Automatic fee waiver explicitly ends November 15, 2026. December 1 complete-application and January 1 discretionary late-review dates are printed without years and are retained as published.

deadlines.label: Automatic application-fee waiver
deadlines.note: Automatic waiver applied within24hours after submission; no request required.

publishedDeadlines.label: Complete application
publishedDeadlines.note: Published Fall timeline without year; $60 fee applies unless waived.

publishedDeadlines.label: Discretionary late review
publishedDeadlines.note: After December1, rolling review only at program discretion.

english.note: Non-native English applicants submit official TOEFL iBT, IELTS or DET. Results within two years. If agency cannot send a report older than one year, upload official copy under Other Documents. No minimum score or waiver policy established on these sources.

applicationFee.note: Automatic waiver for PhD submissions by November 15, 2026, applied within 24 hours; no citizenship restriction stated. Afterward, financial-hardship request by email to SMD graduate admissions; international applicants should confirm hardship eligibility. Epidemiology/Health Services Research $100 SOPHAS exception does not apply to these programs.

requirements.note: Admission requirements list a biological/chemical/biomedical bachelor, laboratory research experience and minimum GPA 3.0. SOP describes pathology interest, research and goals; CV, transcripts and three references, preferably research supervisors. GRE optional; scores above60th percentile described as competitive. Three first-year labs precede mentor selection. Optional concentrations Cancer Biology or Bioinformatics within Pathology, not separate initial applications.

funding.note: Program states full funding: tuition scholarship, health insurance and stipend.
